title: Research: prove the eight-call floor for two dihedral commutator targets
body:
Over formal F2[D8], with only the two adjacent involutions allowed as paid address labels, two central-commutator targets require exactly eight calls despite arbitrary free scalar GL2 mixing. Complete radius-four balls and a separate formal matrix-set verifier certify the minimum and witnesses. Unlike PR1333's alphabet, the central label itself is not a primitive. The result is restricted to two registers and these two paid labels.

Validation: Python 3.12 registered replay with source pins and scoped controls; selected-result integrity or baseline bindings and diff checks pass. See the [reproduction instructions, exact sources and remaining questions](https://github.com/woklerx/integer-mult-bounds/blob/965ff75aabb16cdd0978f4bf9222bcdedf514021/research/bit-dihedral-commutator/README.md). No selected source, certificate or kappa changes; no full selected circuit replay is claimed. Prepared by woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, with predecessor attribution retained.
